Methods log: how we find and check sanctions-evasion leads (Fri 25 Sept 2026)

What we did, how, what it found, what worked, what didn't. Newest entries last in each section. Times EDT. Rating: works · works with care · weak · failed. Findings themselves live in LOG_2026-09-25.md; questions in QUESTIONS_2026-09-25.md.

A. Discovery methods (how we find leads)

#MethodHow (tools / recipe)What it foundRatingLessons

Pre-2014 rows are flagged differently. Rate-limited: 3.5 s between calls. Declared values; latest year may be partial.

Registered-agent addresses (Monrovia) are noise.
A14Listing lagFirst suspicious date vs official listing date (OFAC recent-actions, Federal Register, UK list)RM Design and Development: established 17 Mar 2022 per its own OFAC entry, listed 20 Jul 2023worksOfficial pages only; show lags as "at least".
A15Web corroborationTavily corroborate: official domains first (treasury, OFAC, BIS, gov.uk, EU), then investigative outlets10 of 12 leads confirmed; caught ITIC listed, Sinno's real dateworksAdvanced depth; general topic (news topic missed official pages). Never cite the AI summary: it invented a paragraph once.

B. Verification methods (how we check)

#MethodWhat it caughtRating
B1Independent verifier per investigator (re-derives every figure from saved raw files, never from the report)Figures with no saved file behind them; double-counted totalsworks
B2Official page for every listing dateSinno's "2023-04-20" (OpenSanctions dataset start) vs real 2022-09-30; RM Design 2023-07-20 not Aug 8works
B4Run the tool on known positivesChecker missed "Hoshine Silicon", then "Katrade", then "GTME" (short/transliterated)works (and still finding gaps)
B5Two independent signals per leadStops a shared office address becoming a "front company" claimworks
B7Cross-source triangulation (countries' own statistics vs official pages)Middle-country chip exports jump after 2022 in countries' own reportsworks
B8Save every raw answer with its time; cite the fileMade B1 possible; exposed the file-overwrite bugworks

E. Open method questions

  • How to catch short and transliterated names (GTME) without flooding false positives? (transliteration table; screen IDs, not names)
  • Can the sibling finder rank candidates before they're listed (true prediction), not just re-find same-wave listings?
  • How to separate a real 2024 drop (bank pressure after E.O. 14114) from gaps in the data?
  • How to verify registration dates without official registries?
